_doc: Como moderno (mismo render, luces, contorno y escala: conviven en el mismo juego) pero el prompt pide un personaje semi-realista: proporciones reales, piel, pelo y telas creíbles, apenas estilizado. Probado en dos humanoides (2026-10-19, con prompt escrito a mano equivalente).

prompt.render_personaje: a semi-realistic 3D game character: high quality CGI render with realistic proportions and realistic skin, hair, fabric and metal materials, only slightly stylized, like a character from a high-end modern video game or a modern animated film. Not anime, not cartoon, not chibi, not a toy, not a photograph, no outlines
prompt.render_objeto: a semi-realistic 3D game prop: high quality CGI render with realistic proportions and materials, only slightly stylized, no outlines
prompt.tema: contemporary everyday world: casual clothes, plastic, denim, cardboard, painted metal
prompt.paleta: bright but balanced colors, clean saturated primaries with neutral greys
prompt.extra: soft studio lighting, plain light grey background
